snippet.title: Rope-Kun Adventure　Trailer Movie 2
snippet.description:
This is a trailer movie of the game “Rope-kun Adventure” in development.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
A very unique puzzle-action game in which the main character "Rope-kun", who wields a rope, overcomes various gimmicks!
The possibilities for ropes are endless, from carrying objects, to bouncing balls, to tying up and defeating enemies!
Overcome with him the many difficulties that await you!
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2919070

Web : https://www.kei26.com
SNS : https://twitter.com/kei26game
